description:
in the month of July,August,September,October ,under the chairmanship of PRID Rtn. Ashok Mahajan, the Rotary Club of Mulund has given the Gift of Life to 240 children through life-saving paediatric heart surgeries performed at Fortis, Jupiter, and KIMS Hospitals.

This is one of our flagship humanitarian projects and an ongoing commitment to ensuring that no child is denied a healthy future because of financial constraints.

During this Rotary year, we have set ourselves an ambitious goal of providing the Gift of Life to 1,000 children, and we are committed to working tirelessly to achieve it.

I express my heartfelt gratitude to our generous donors, partners, hospitals, and every Rotarian whose support and compassion make this noble mission possible. Together, we are not just saving young lives—we are giving hope to families and building a healthier future for our society.

Thank you all for your continued encouragement and support.

Rtn. Nutan
President
Rotary Club of Mulund
